title: 天皇賞（春）の後に・敗戦の喜び

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ryan gives it her all, but she loses to Mejiro McQueen, who has spent her entire life preparing for the spring Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: McQueen respects Ryan's effort, and promises that their next race will be medium distance—Ryan's specialty.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The next goal is the Takarazuka Kinen, which decides the spring medium-distance champion. But will Mejiro Ryan be able to place high enough in the fan poll to enter?
